cd /workspace/tmp/tests && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, random, sys, time
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/tmp/tests']
from cli import run
rng=random.Random(9)
NS=16
names=['S%02d'%i for i in range(NS)]
reg=[{'name':n,'label':4294967290-i} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
LIM={'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
policies=[]
for k in range(16):
    ws=set()
    while len(ws)<250: ws.add(tuple(rng.choice(names) for _ in range(16)))
    policies.append(' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(w) for w in ws))
events=[{'op':'stage','epoch':4294967000+k,'policy':policies[k]} for k in range(16)]
events.append({'op':'commit','epoch':4294967015})
for i in range(1,300): events.append({'op':'spawn','unit':[4294967295,i,4294967295],'service':names[i%NS]})
while len(events)<200000: events.append({'op':'inspect'})
data=json.dumps({'jobs':[{'services':reg,'limits':LIM,'events':events}]},separators=(',',':')).encode()
open('/workspace/tmp/big.json','wb').write(data)
print('input',len(data))
t=time.time()
st,out,err,dt=run(data)
print('status',st,'cli time %.2fs'%dt,'out bytes',len(out),'stderr',err[:300])
r=json.loads(out)
print('stages ok',sum(1 for x in r['results'][0]['events'][:16] if x.get('ok')))
print('rows per image',[len(x['image']['rows']) for x in r['results'][0]['events'][:16]])
print('last',json.dumps(r['results'][0]['events'][-1])[:200])
EOF
